d:
Manually moved the english text from doujin chapters to the tank raws, translated around ~20ish pages from scratch, adjusted and fixed some minor typesetting errors and translated new text wherever possible to make the tank complete.

Credits:
Ch.1 Slave in Another World - Bruh Monkey (+ I did the last 10 pages, mostly because I didn’t realize there was another version with those pages, but I think it was worth the effort)
Ch.2 Witch in Another World - RedLantern
Ch.3 Barmaid in Another World - RedLantern
Ch.4 Nun in Another World - Little White Butterflies
Ch.5 Adventurer in Another World - DLSite ver.
Ch.6 Saint in Another World - DLSite ver.
Ch.7 Domesticated Succubus - DLSite ver.
Ch.8 Saint in Another World Side Story - Me

For the chapters that had credits page (Chapter 2-4), I appended them at the end of the tank.
Cheers and thanks to everyone who contributed!
